data.gender_notes: Apollo is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: God of the Sun and Light
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Apollo is recorded in name-lists as “God of the Sun and Light”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Apollo expresses “God of the Sun and Light”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Apollo total 26, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.

in_hebrew.name: Apollo
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו God of the Sun and Light
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Apollo הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Greek mythology, Apollo is the god of the Sun, music, poetry, art, and prophecy. He is also associated with archery, plague, medicine, and knowledge.

in_greek.name: Apollo
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει God of the Sun and Light
in_greek.long_meaning: Apollo είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. In Greek mythology, Apollo is the god of the Sun, music, poetry, art, and prophecy. He is also associated with archery, plague, medicine, and knowledge.

in_latin.name: Apollo
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat God of the Sun and Light
in_latin.long_meaning: Apollo est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. In Greek mythology, Apollo is the god of the Sun, music, poetry, art, and prophecy. He is also associated with archery, plague, medicine, and knowledge.
